scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's Newsroom, Business reporting, Design guides, Creator trends, 2026 Hobbies report, November content calendar and linked public inspiration were checked on 8 November 2026. No newer featured Newsroom item appeared after the 26 October Programmatic Deals announcement. The current Creator page features Copper Hair, Suede Styling, Vamp Romantic and Glamoratti; the Beauty report frames copper/cherry-cola hair, maximalist makeup and dark reflective details as specific, personal edits rather than copy-exact looks. The Hobbies report continues tactile, screen-free making, zines, collages and analogue observation. Pinterest Business's Design the Exit guidance adds an intent-led discovery-to-action structure, while Barbie Restyle demonstrates reference-based room comparison and focused add/swap/erase edits. These durable methods are already represented by /beauty-trend-system, /emotional-palette, /trend-to-brand, /zine-editorial-system, /intent-to-action, /spatial-restyle-system and existing fashion, social, UGC and campaign systems. Four linked public inspiration pages returned HTTP 403, so no unsupported visual conclusion was derived from them.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.28.0 with 723 commands, 42 categories and 40 bundles was read from GitHub main and compared with Drive before evaluation. /beauty-trend-system already converts precise hair, makeup and nail references into identity-safe editorial, close-detail, product and UGC variants; /emotional-palette and /trend-to-brand cover palette translation without replacing the brand. /intent-to-action already maps active intent through discovery, confidence, decision and a proportional real-world CTA, matching Design the Exit. /spatial-restyle-system already locks room geometry and camera while producing comparable directions and focused add, remove or swap passes, covering the Restyle method. /zine-editorial-system, /content-lifecycle-system, fashion/wardrobe systems and social/campaign bundles cover the remaining monthly and seasonal signals. New copper, suede, Vamp Romantic, Glamoratti, Restyle or Design the Exit aliases would be redundant or short-lived, so the userscript and metadata remained byte-identical. All 22 regression checks passed.
trends: Copper Hair, Vamp Romantic and Glamoratti reinforce precise, personalised beauty editing: warm copper/cherry tones, dark reflective details, sculptural makeup and maximalist styling
Suede Styling remains a seasonal wardrobe and tactile-material signal rather than a reusable production method
Design the Exit frames creative as a short path from possibility through useful guidance to a specific real-world next step
Barbie Restyle demonstrates reference-based spatial comparison with geometry-preserving add, swap, erase and prompt edits
Hobby signals continue tactile, screen-free making, zine/collage systems, naturalist observation and analogue storytelling
Pinterest Palette and Design guides continue exact named hues, restrained palette systems, expressive display typography and disciplined brand-kit rules
Pinterest’s latest featured Newsroom update remains Programmatic Deals and does not add a new visual-production grammar
skipped: No Copper Hair, Vamp Romantic or Glamoratti aliases because /beauty-trend-system, /emotional-palette and existing portrait, fashion, product and UGC workflows already cover the reusable method without hard-coding a seasonal look
No Suede Styling alias because existing fashion, wardrobe, material-realism and campaign systems already cover the transferable method
No Design the Exit alias because /intent-to-action already covers active intent, useful guidance, friction removal, a proportional CTA and a real-world next step

No Barbie Restyle alias because /spatial-restyle-system and focused image-editing commands already preserve architecture and camera while comparing directions and performing controlled add, remove or swap edits
No November Illuminate, Homemade, Gratitude or Harvest aliases because /content-lifecycle-system and existing social, storyboard, food, lifestyle and campaign systems already handle seasonal planning
No visual claims were derived from the four linked public Pinterest inspiration pages that returned HTTP 403
